titles.title: Pink Moon and Blue Lines

description: A pink circle sits within a central, rectangular strip of blue. Flanking these objects are overlapping vertical forms that curl inward at their tops, similar to the petals of a flower. These forms are painted in shades of white, pale pink, green, and yellow, contrasting with a dark blue background.
title: Pink Moon and Blue Lines
